title: Estimating Career Benefits from Online Community Leadership: Evidence from Stack Exchange Moderators
eligible_reason: The DiD compares election winners (moderators, mod==1) with losing candidates (mod==0) before/after Stack Exchange moderator elections. The main DiD outcome model (Table 4) is a Cox proportional-hazards model of job change (stcox i.after##i.mod i.relt, strata(candidate_id)), i.e., nonlinear. The only linear DiD (Table 7: xtreg salary i.after##i.mod i.relt, fe) uses candidate FE plus relative-time (half-years since election, relt 2-7) fixed effects and an additive `after` main effect; the shipped data contain no calendar-time variable, so unit + calendar-time FE cannot be formed. Elections occur at different dates, but the reported design is a winner-vs-loser relative-time design, not a staggered-adoption TWFE with calendar-time FE. Remaining tables are RDD (vote-share margin), logits and mediation models.
design_notes: Panel of moderator-election candidates (identifiers disguised). did.dta: employment-spell half-year panel (epiid, spell_elapsed_time, T0, job_change, after, mod, relt 0-7, CEM/PSM weights). did_salary.dta: candidate half-year panel (salary, after, mod, relt 2-7). Table 4: stcox with strata(candidate_id), vce(robust), CEM / PSM / unweighted (analysis.do lines 274-279). Table 7: xtreg salary i.after##i.mod i.relt [pw=cem_weight|psm_weight|none], fe r (lines 422-424). Tables 5, 8-10: RDD around vote share (rdd.dta); Table 9 mediation (medeff); Table 10 logits.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Elections span many dates across communities, but the shipped panels index time relative to the election (relt) only.
never_treated_note: Controls are losing candidates in the same elections (all observe the event; `after` is defined for both groups).

specs.exclusion_reason: relative-time FE (relt) instead of calendar-time FE; additive `after` main effect; no calendar date in data
specs.treatment_definition: mod = won the moderator election; after = half-year is after the election (defined for winners and losers)

ineligible_specs.reason: RDD on vote share, mediation, logit

data_files_note: Identifiers disguised and descriptive datasets (candidates_full/did/rdd) withheld for anonymity; DiD and RDD analysis files are shipped.
software_detail: Stata 16 (stcox, xtreg, reg, logit, medeff, esttab, outreg2)
priority_note: Not eligible (hazard model; relative-time FE; no calendar-time variable).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Checked did_salary.dta and did.dta variable lists with pandas: no calendar date/election date variable present (only relt).
